simple.meaning: שָׁגַל (shâgal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to copulate with.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Deuteronomy, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Zechariah, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:30. Its contexts include city, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁגַל (H7693).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁגַל (shâgal) / H7693 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:30, Isaiah 13:16, Jeremiah 3:2, Zechariah 14:2 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H7693. shagel [ שָׁגֵל ] verb violate, ravish (Masoretes think verb obscene, and substitute שָׁכַב ); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה Deut 28:30 Kt (Qr יִשְׁכָּבֶנָּה ). Niph`al Imperfect 3feminine plural תִּשָּׁגַלְנָה Isa 13:16 ; Zech 14:2 women shall be ravished (both Kt; Qr תִּשְּׁכַבְנָה ). Punic < Qal passive (Ges § 52e ) Perfect 2feminine singular שֻׁגַּלְתְּ לֹא אֵיפֹה Jer 3:2 where hast thou not been ravished ? (Qr שֻׁכַּבְתְּ ).

occurrences.englishText: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

“Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.
